messages:
alex: running a microbatch sizing sweep for streaming chat vs non-streaming completions. with kernel auto-select + kv cache on. streaming p99 spikes when mb >= 16, throughput improves. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:

maria: seen it on rtx-pool. streaming keeps long tail if batch assembly waits on slow requests. chat p99 is user-facing so smaller mb often wins despite lower qps.

chris: data point from my bench:
```
streaming mb=8  -> p95 115ms p99 230ms qps 260
streaming mb=16 -> p95 88ms  p99 540ms qps 430
nonstream mb=16 -> p95 125ms p99 310ms qps 600
```
mb=16 really blows up p99 for streaming.

yun: check kernel fallback traces. sometimes kernel auto picks a slower matmul path for short seqs which hurts streaming. also watch kv evictions (cold cache -> spikes).

alex: any recommended kneepoint heuristic? thinking static vs dynamic.

chris: we used dynamic_knee that watches recent p99 and drops mb when p99 > SLO. bounds [4,24] and max_wait 12ms worked well for us. cuts p99 with ~10% qps loss vs big static batches.

maria: config we ran: 
```
"batching": {"policy":"dynamic_knee","min_mb":4,"max_mb":24,"max_wait_ms":12},
"kv_cache": {"enabled": true, "max_items": 20000}
```
include cold vs warm KV runs. cold cache hides batching benefits.

perf-bot: benchmark #2041 finished. summary:
- streaming mb=8: p95=118ms p99=238ms qps=255
- streaming mb=16: p95=90ms p99=548ms qps=428
- nonstream mb=16: p95=130ms p99=305ms qps=612
logs: https://perf.redwood/bench/2041 (internal)

sam: another lever: kernel_hint. force smoothed_attention for streaming tests; it can reduce jitter on short sequences. quantized kernels sometimes regress for tiny batches.

alex: plan: run three experiments today -> (A) streaming static mb=8 + kernel_hint=smoothed_attention, (B) dynamic_knee bounds [4,16], (C) non-streaming baseline mb=24. will collect flamegraphs, kernel traces, kv metrics.

maria: add run with prefix caching disabled to separate kernel vs kv effects. also record assembly wait histogram.

alex: kicking off runs. will post perf-bot links and flamegraphs here when done. thread_ts=1937654321
